SuraLink Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 22, 2026

SuraLink helps you understand and practice Quranic words and passages and learn how to pray. SuraLink does not include advertising networks and does not sell your data.

Your SuraLink account

SuraLink asks you to create a free account so your learning is backed up and can move with you to a new device. You can sign in with Apple, with Google, or with an email address and password. Accounts are provided by Google Firebase Authentication. We receive your email address (or, with Sign in with Apple, the email or private relay address Apple shares) and a user ID. Passwords are handled by Firebase and are never visible to us.

Your learning backup

While you are signed in, a copy of your learning (progress, vocabulary, review schedules, bookmarks, activity, preferences and memorization records) is stored in Google Cloud Firestore, linked to your user ID, so it can be restored when you sign in again. Only you can read or change your backup. The app also keeps a copy on your device so it works offline.

Deleting your account

You can delete your account at any time in the app: Profile, Settings, Your account, Delete account. This permanently deletes your account and its cloud backup. If you used Sign in with Apple, the app also revokes SuraLink's access to your Apple ID. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription. Manage Apple purchases in your Apple ID settings and Google Play purchases in Google Play. If you cannot access the app, see our account deletion request instructions.

Reminders

If you turn on daily reminders, they are scheduled on your device as local notifications. No push-notification server is used, and you can turn reminders off in Settings or in your device settings.

Microphone and speech recognition

Recitation practice requests microphone and speech-recognition access when you choose to use voice input. Speech is processed by your device or its configured speech provider, including Apple on iOS and the installed Android speech service on Android, depending on device support and configuration. SuraLink compares recognized text with the passage on your device and does not store your recordings. You can use typed recall instead.

Location and prayer times

With your permission, your location is used to calculate Qibla direction and retrieve prayer times from Aladhan (api.aladhan.com). Coordinates are sent to Aladhan for the prayer-time lookup. Precise GPS coordinates are not saved in your learning data. If you choose a city instead, the city's approximate coordinates are used.

Subscriptions

Apple handles iOS purchases and Google Play handles Android purchases and payment information. RevenueCat verifies subscription status, grants access to paid features and provides purchase analytics; it is linked to your SuraLink user ID so a subscription follows your account. RevenueCat may process app-user identifiers, purchase information and technical data for that purpose. See RevenueCat's privacy policy. Offer codes are redeemed through the store that issued them.

Audio and external services

When you listen, the app requests audio from providers such as the Al Quran Cloud audio network (cdn.islamic.network), QuranWBW and Hisn al-Muslim. On iOS, the app also checks the App Store for a newer version. Android may read app update settings from Firebase. These requests expose network information, such as your IP address, to those providers. External links open their respective services, which have their own privacy practices.

Keeping and removing data

Your account and cloud backup are kept until you delete your account. Data on your device remains until you remove the app. Purchase records are managed by Apple or Google Play, depending on where you subscribed. External providers apply their own retention practices. Contact us below with any questions or requests about your data.

Content and changes

Chapter names and verse counts are based on Quran.com metadata. Word meanings are adapted from the Quranic Arabic Corpus. Hadith are from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. Guided explanations are distinct from the Quran text. Changes to this policy will be posted on this page.
